## Summary

## Type of Change

- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Code
- [ ] Data schema or config

## Data, License, and Ethics Check

- [ ] No raw restricted data is included.
- [ ] No API keys, credentials, or private files are included.
- [ ] Source metadata is updated if data sources changed.
- [ ] License/redistribution status is clear.
- [ ] PII risk was considered.
- [ ] Limitations are documented where relevant.

- [ ] `kreyolbench validate-dataset`

- [ ] Not applicable
